parts.note: beyond, as in further than or after, means past
EL is the American short name for an elevated railway, as in Chicago

explanation.surface: A shade of paint described by where it sits relative to an elevated train line.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft, light tint such as baby blue is a pastel shade.

clue.text: One of a number of drinkers who are anonymous

definitions.text: One of a number of drinkers who are anonymous

parts.words: One of a number of drinkers who are anonymous
parts.note: points to the self-help fellowship whose members meet anonymously to stop drinking

explanation.surface: A description of a member of a support group for problem drinkers.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue leans on the name of the fellowship Alcoholics Anonymous: each member is one of the drinkers who remain anonymous.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of that fellowship are people addicted to drink, each one a member of the named group.

indicators.note: fantastic, meaning fanciful or wildly imagined, tells us to rearrange the words ethical and logo

explanation.surface: An imaginative moral emblem for a faith.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fantastic' looks like praise for the logo but is the anagram signal for ETHICAL plus LOGO.
explanation.definitionFit: Something concerning the study of God and faith is described with this adjective, a direct synonym.

clue.text: The Parisian can concede a goal

parts.note: le is the French for 'the', so a Parisian would say it
a can is a tin container

explanation.surface: A Paris footballer, or a goalkeeper, might be able to give away a goal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can' looks like the verb 'is able to', but it is the noun, a tin.
explanation.definitionFit: A goalkeeper who allows the ball past is said to let it in, an idiom for conceding.

clue.text: Send off Desmond with Patricia Church

parts.note: Des is the short form of the name Desmond
Pat is the short form of the name Patricia

explanation.surface: Seeing off a man called Desmond together with a woman from the church.
explanation.definitionFit: To send a letter or messenger off on its way is to dispatch it; this spelling is a recognised variant.

definitions.meaning: a shrub bearing white flowers and dark berries used for cordial and wine
in Presbyterian churches a lay official with authority, and generally an older, senior person

explanation.surface: A description of a president named Bush as a senior clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bush' suggests the US president, but here it is a shrub, the elderberry plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The shrub elderflower grows on is this plant, and a church office-holder in many Protestant churches bears this title.

parts.note: prudish means prim, stiffly proper
P is the abbreviation for a penny in British currency

explanation.surface: An instruction to tend to a straitlaced woman called Penny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Groom' reads as a bridegroom or a horse handler, but it is the verb, to make neat.
explanation.definitionFit: To groom oneself fussily, smartening up hair and clothes, is a synonym in verb form.

definitions.meaning: follows secretly, as a detective shadows a suspect
the shout made while a coin spins, heads or the other side

explanation.surface: Someone shadows another and shouts after a coin toss.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits that the call is made once the coin has been tossed, choosing the reverse side.
explanation.definitionFit: A private eye shadowing someone does this verb; the call for the reverse face of a coin is this word too.

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker, as in a farm hand
a lad, a boy, is a son

explanation.surface: A labourer's boy taking a personal part in things.
explanation.definitionFit: A manager who gets directly engaged in the practical work is described with this hyphenated adjective.

clue.text: Perhaps a grave sign of stress

definitions.meaning: the grave is one example of the marks written over vowels, as in the French è
emphasis laid on a syllable when speaking

explanation.surface: A serious matter may show that someone is under strain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grave' reads as serious or a burial place, but it is the diacritic mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The grave mark is one kind of diacritic, and emphasis on a syllable in speech is called by the same word.

clue.text: Total charge, it is included in mathematical operation

indicators.note: says the word it is placed within the other pieces

parts.note: to total figures is to add them up
an ion is an atom bearing an electric charge

explanation.surface: Billing for an overall fee, with a calculation built in.
explanation.definitionFit: Summing numbers is one of the four basic arithmetic processes, alongside subtraction.

indicators.note: organised, meaning arranged, tells us to put the letters of hospital, trip and NHS into a new order

explanation.surface: Charitable donors fund a hospital outing arranged by Britain's National Health Service.
explanation.walkthrough: NHS is Britain's National Health Service.
explanation.definitionFit: Generous donors who give money to good causes are synonymous with this plural noun.

indicators.note: fabricated, meaning made up, tells us to rearrange the letters of log I had

explanation.surface: An aristocrat confesses that his journal was invented.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish gentleman of minor noble rank is given this title.

parts.note: or introduces an alternative
a bit is a piece or section

explanation.surface: Choosing a different segment of a round shape.
explanation.definitionFit: To circle a planet is to travel around it in a path, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Make misleading insertions police organisation took in

parts.note: Interpol is the international police organisation
to take food in is to eat it, so took in means ate

explanation.surface: An international police body accused of doctoring files it absorbed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'took in' suggests deceived or accepted, but here it is consumed food.
explanation.definitionFit: Adding spurious passages to a text, corrupting it, is the specific verb sense here.

indicators.note: says one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a bed is a plot of garden, as in a rose bed
a light bulb is a light

explanation.surface: A flower bulb planted among the roses has fallen sick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bulb' fits the gardening picture, but it is an electric bulb.
explanation.definitionFit: Plants struck by fungal disease are said to suffer blight, giving this adjective for infected.

parts.note: a banker in crosswords is a river, something with banks; this one names a cloth too

explanation.surface: The suit fabric worn by a City financier.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tweed is a river on the English-Scottish border, and its name is also the rough woollen cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: The woollen fabric shares its name with the border river, so a river's cloth names it.

parts.note: yet, meaning however, is but

indicators.note: returning tells us to read the word not backwards

explanation.surface: An item of clothing that still won't come back.
explanation.definitionFit: A small disc sewn on a shirt to close it is the familiar example of a clothing fastening.

parts.note: in cricket scoring c & b means caught and bowled, both ways of dismissing a batsman

explanation.walkthrough: C and B are each a way of being dismissed in cricket, caught and bowled, so the batsman is dismissed twice over, an expression meaning utter or complete.
explanation.definitionFit: Caught and bowled are two dismissals joined by 'and', giving the phrase meaning thorough or complete.

clue.text: It's a hangover from freezing weather

definitions.text: It's a hangover from freezing weather

parts.words: It's a hangover from freezing weather
parts.note: hangover read literally: something that hangs down, formed of frozen drips

explanation.walkthrough: 'hangover' suggests the morning after drinking, but means a thing hanging from a gutter or eave.
explanation.definitionFit: A tapering spike of frozen water dangling from a roof edge forms in a cold snap.

clue.text: I name copper taking vehicle during nightmare

indicators.note: taking means the next piece is added on to those before it

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a bus is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone recalls naming a policeman who boarded a bus in a bad dream.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' suggests a policeman, but it is the metal, symbol Cu.
explanation.definitionFit: A demon thought to oppress sleepers, and by extension an oppressive dream, is this noun.

clue.text: Struggling Letitia right to include learned people

indicators.note: says the rearranged name takes the abbreviation inside it
struggling, meaning in difficulty, tells us to rearrange the letters of Letitia

explanation.surface: A woman called Letitia, in difficulty, is right to invite scholars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Struggling' makes LITEATI from LETITIA, and 'to include' places R inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The well-read intellectual class are referred to by this Latin-derived plural noun.

clue.text: Rang Bill about two, say, and demanded explanation of what he had done

definitions.text: demanded explanation of what he had done

parts.note: to ring someone is to call them, so rang means called

indicators.note: say marks that the number is heard rather than written

parts.note: the number two is said like the little word to
a bill is an account, a statement of money owed

explanation.surface: Someone phoned a man named Bill about two o'clock and asked him to justify himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a name but is an invoice.
explanation.definitionFit: Being required to justify one's conduct before an authority is the idiom's meaning.

clue.text: Went first round ancient city one had been attracted to

indicators.note: says the first piece goes around the other

parts.note: to go first is to lead, so went first means led
Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city

explanation.surface: An explorer led the way around an ancient city that had drawn them there.
explanation.definitionFit: Tempted or enticed, the past form of a verb meaning to draw someone in.

indicators.note: reformed, as in re-formed or remade, tells us to rearrange the letters of those

explanation.surface: The character of people who have mended their ways.
explanation.definitionFit: The characteristic spirit or guiding beliefs of a community is this Greek-derived noun.

indicators.note: unfinished means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: a trader is a merchant ship

explanation.surface: Commercial matters on board a vessel left incomplete.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unfinished' drops the final R of TRADER.
explanation.definitionFit: Commerce, buying and selling, is a synonym for business in this sense.

clue.text: Tom goes round employment department for trainee

indicators.note: says the first piece wraps around the second

parts.note: a tom is a male cat
DE is the abbreviation for the former British Department of Employment

explanation.surface: A man named Tom does the rounds of the job centre in search of an apprentice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tom' looks like a man's name, but here it is a male cat.
explanation.definitionFit: A young recruit training for the armed forces or police is called by this noun.

clue.text: This suit appears without a stitch

definitions.text: This suit appears without a stitch

parts.words: This suit appears without a stitch
parts.note: the 'suit' worn with not a stitch on is the naked skin one is born in

explanation.walkthrough: A tailor's suit wants to come to mind, but the suit is a person's bare skin, as in the jokey idiom for nakedness.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'in one's ___ suit' means naked, as on the day one was born.

clue.text: Monster will continue slowly and tediously

definitions.meaning: a fire-breathing winged beast of legend
a phrasal verb for going on too long, as a dull meeting does

explanation.surface: A beast that keeps going on and on tiresomely.
explanation.definitionFit: A legendary fire-breathing beast is this word, and split in two it is a verb phrase meaning to go on wearily.

parts.note: front, a show of pretence, is side, as in putting on side or airs
a step is a pace taken in walking

explanation.surface: Dodging something by walking ahead of it.
explanation.walkthrough: SIDE is old-fashioned slang for pretentious airs, a synonym for 'front'.
explanation.definitionFit: To dodge a question or a tackle by stepping aside is to evade it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Attempt to become a consumer in contract

indicators.note: says the second piece is placed inside the first

parts.note: an attempt is a try
a consumer of food eats it

explanation.surface: Trying to turn into a customer under the terms of an agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'consumer' suggests a shopper, but here it is someone eating.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal agreement between nations is a type of binding written contract.
